_comment: Corpus collection template. Copy this file, rename it to a meaningful name (e.g. corpus-batch-01.json), fill in real data, and place finished batches in data/raw/. The Python pipeline (scripts/01_build_corpus.py) validates and merges them into src/data/texts.json. Remove all _comment fields before submitting.

texts.tradition: REQUIRED one of: greek | norse | hindu | chinese | maori | yoruba | japanese | maya | egyptian | hebrew | mesopotamian | aztec | slavic | celtic | buddhist | korean | akan | hawaiian | inuit | (add your own, then register it in src/lib/colors.js TRADITIONS)
texts.category: REQUIRED one of: myth | religious | myth-religion — 'religious' is reserved for pure-religion traditions only (hebrew/Judaism, christian/Christianity, islamic/Islam, buddhist/Buddhism, taoist/Taoism); all other traditions use 'myth' for sacred narratives, and 'myth-religion' where myth and religion share one origin (e.g. Hindu, Norse, Yoruba, Afro-Atlantic, Celtic, Tibetan). Classification is interpretive — note your reasoning in the sensitivity note if ambiguous.
texts._coords_comment: Approximate/symbolic coordinates. Document how you chose them (Wikipedia place article, gazetteer). Use a neutral inland spot for otherworldly/symbolic places and say so in region/summary.
texts.period: REQUIRED e.g. 'c. 8th-5th c. BCE' or 'recorded 19th c.'

source.archive: REQUIRED e.g. 'Project Gutenberg', 'Internet Sacred Texts Archive', 'Perseus Digital Library', 'Wikisource'
source.work: REQUIRED exact work + translator/editor if known
source.url: REQUIRED verify a working URL at collection time; empty string only if genuinely unavailable

motifs: REQUIRED list of motif ids matching src/data/motifs.json; tag 1-5 motifs per text

sensitivity.note: REQUIRED for any tradition with content restrictions (e.g. some First Nations material). Explain what is excluded and why. Set restricted=true and the text must not be included.

passages.text: REQUIRED verbatim public-domain excerpt (preferred) or clearly-labeled condensed paraphrase. 40-200 words each. 1-4 passages per text. Quote exactly; keep the source's spelling.
